<document id="plan-plus">
The Plus plan
Plus costs $5.00 a month. It's built for people who use their card a lot away from BrookLink ATMs or spend some time abroad, and it adds Cushion and a higher savings rate.

## What's included

- **Monthly fee:** $5.00
- **ATMs:** free at BrookLink ATMs, plus 3 free out-of-network withdrawals a month. After that it's $2.50 per withdrawal.
- **Foreign transaction fee:** 1% of the purchase amount
- **Card replacement:** free
- **Expedited card shipping:** $25.00
- **Savings Pockets:** 2.00% APY
- **Cushion:** fee-free coverage up to $50.00 on debit card purchases
- **Daily card spending limit:** $5,000
- **Daily ATM limit:** $1,000

## Good to know

Plus includes outgoing international wires for $35.00 each. Your card is plastic, like Basic. Upgrade to Premium if you want the metal card.

You can change plans any time in the app under Profile, then Plan. Upgrades start right away. Downgrades start on your next billing date.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.
</document>
<document id="plans-compare">
Compare plans: features and limits
All three plans come with a Visa debit card, the Tallowbrook app, BrookPay transfers to other members, Savings Pockets and support around the clock. They differ in fees, limits and a few features.

| Feature | Basic | Plus | Premium |
|---|---|---|---|
| Card | plastic | plastic | metal |
| Savings APY | 0.50% | 2.00% | 3.75% |
| Cushion | not available | up to $50.00 | up to $200 |
| Daily card spending | $3,000 | $5,000 | $10,000 |
| Daily ATM withdrawals | $500 | $1,000 | $1,500 |
| Daily ACH transfers out | $2,500 | $5,000 | $10,000 |
| Outgoing international wires | not available | yes | yes |
| Emergency card abroad | no | no | yes |

Fees are listed in the article "Fees for all plans". This page covers features and limits only.

## Which plan fits

Basic suits people who mostly use BrookLink ATMs and don't travel. Plus suits people who want Cushion and a better savings rate for a small monthly fee. Premium suits frequent travelers and people with larger balances, since the savings rate and the missing foreign fees can more than cover the monthly fee.

You can switch plans in the app at any time.

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is there around the clock.
</document>
<document id="disputes-duplicate">
Charged twice for the same thing
Seeing the same charge twice doesn't always mean you were charged twice.

## Check if one is pending

Hotels, gas stations, car rentals and restaurants often place a temporary authorization, then post the final amount separately. The pending one usually drops off within 7 days. Pending transactions can't be disputed.

## If both have posted

If two identical charges have both posted, contact the merchant first. Most will refund a duplicate quickly. If the merchant doesn't help, dispute the second charge in the app as a duplicate. Tap the transaction, then Get help, then Charged twice.

## Duplicate fees

If we charged you the same fee twice, message support. A fee charged in error is always refunded.

## Time limit

Duplicate charges follow the merchant dispute window: 120 days from the transaction date.

## Split payments

Some merchants split one order into several charges, for example when items ship separately. Check your order confirmation before you dispute.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.
</document>
</documents>
